# Decision Notes (Portal)

**Document ID:** GLOBAL-PORTAL-DECISION-NOTES

**Schema version:** 1

**Kind:** reference

**Lifecycle:** current

**Subject:** pointer from the path of the pre-policy decision notes, which source comments cite, to their archive record

**Surface:** portal

**Boundary:** global

**Authority role:** portal

**Mutation:** authored

**Indexing:** pointer-only

**Canonical:** docs/archive/decision-notes-2026-10-12.md

The decision notes that source comments cite as `docs/notas.md` are archived,
whole and in Portuguese, as
[PXL-ARCHIVE-001](archive/decision-notes-2026-10-12.md). A citation such as
`docs/notas.md, 4.13` names a section of that record, and a number such as
`(5.2)` names a question answered in it. Current facts are owned elsewhere; see
the [documentation index](README.md).
